title: Hand the microphone to a moving banquet host

verification_methodology.disclosure: Uses the verified Shure SM58 stage microphone GLB (89d38b9c, GRIP420, CC BY, 3 PBR maps) plus BEHAVIOR-1K microphone (eyleyk) runtime metadata, native Genie banquet tables/plates, and Rocketbox banquet host and seated speaker. The microphone is a free 6-DOF MuJoCo rigid body held by TIAGo's right gripper via bounded compliant grasp wrench; host walk-and-stop motion is identical in both branches.
